name: DTC Unallocated Adjustment Reason 4 Code
definition: DTC Unallocated reason codes for payment adjustments.

LFID.name: After Cycle Cut Off
LFID.definition: Issues funded and/or identified after the cycle cut off.

APRR.name: Approximate Rate
APRR.definition: Rate is not final. Rate is approximate.

RESC.name: Call Rescinded
RESC.definition: Reason is due to a call rescinded.

CDIN.name: Canadian Depository Inventory
CDIN.definition: Reason is due to a Canadian depository inventory.

CSHR.name: Cash Rate Unknown
CSHR.definition: Cash rate for allocation is unknown.

ERLY.name: CD Accelerated Maturity
ERLY.definition: Reason is due to a CD accelerated maturity.

COND.name: Conditional Payment
COND.definition: Payment is conditional and conditions have not been met yet.

FVDG.name: Five Day Grace Period
FVDG.definition: Reason is due to a five day grace period.

ANFI.name: Funds Not Received By Agent
ANFI.definition: Funds were not received by the agent.

SAGA.name: Grace Period
SAGA.definition: Company is taking a 30 day grace period.

HICO.name: Holiday In Country Of Origin
HICO.definition: Reason is due to holiday in country of origin.

ISNF.name: Issue Not Funded
ISNF.definition: Reason is due to issue that was not funded.

NMAT.name: Issue Not Maturing
NMAT.definition: Reason is due to issue that is not maturing.

PEND.name: Item Is Pending
PEND.definition: Reason is due to items pending.

MSTK.name: Maturity For Stock Payment Option
MSTK.definition: Reason is due to maturity for stock payment option.

NOTL.name: Notional Balance
NOTL.definition: Notional balance principal will not be paid.

MASF.name: Insufficient Funds Received From Agent
MASF.definition: Reason is due to insufficient funds received from the agent.

OFAC.name: Funds Held At Chase For OFAC
OFAC.definition: Reason is due to funds held at Chase for official foreign asset control.

FDIC.name: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation
FDIC.definition: Reason is due to a failed bank; Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation assumed.

CHBD.name: Church Bond Not Funded
CHBD.definition: Reason is due to a church bond not funded.

CHIP.name: CHIPS Payment
CHIP.definition: Reason is due to a CHIPS Payment.

CSHU.name: Cash Rate Zero
CSHU.definition: Cash rate for allocation is zero.

SPNF.name: Special Distribution Not Yet Funded
SPNF.definition: Reason is due to special distribution and the issue was not funded.

SDPC.name: Same Day Position Capture
SDPC.definition: Reason is due to same day position capture.

SANF.name: Sale Of Assets Not Yet Funded
SANF.definition: Reason is that due to sale of asset, issue was not funded.

RPLG.name: Released Pledge Position
RPLG.definition: Reason is due to released pledge position.

RRNF.name: Redemption Of Rates Not Yet Funded
RRNF.definition: Reason is that due to redemption of rates, issue was not funded.

RCNF.name: Recapitalisation Not Funded
RCNF.definition: Reason is due to recapitalisation and issue not funded.

PLEG.name: Pledged Position
PLEG.definition: Reason is due to pledged position.

RRFX.name: Pending Conversion Of Funds
RRFX.definition: Reason is due to pending conversion of funds.

PCHK.name: Paid Upon Receipt Of Check
PCHK.definition: Reason is due paid upon receipt of check.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Reserved for new user defined reason codes.
